Long, flowing salt-white hair and a thick, wild salt-white beard that reach the chest. Glowing neon-cyan eyes with a menacing, wide-eyed expression. An ancient, mature appearance with a weathered, rugged face. A colossal, towering build with hyper-muscular proportions. Wears a dark teal leather harness and gold ornate bracers over a bronze-plated chest piece. Features a shimmering gold crown of coral and a massive, three-pronged golden trident.
BODY COLOR: tanned olive skin
